description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role Overview

Ema is hiring an Account Executive for the Middle East, based in Dubai. You will open and grow Ema's business across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, with the wider GCC to follow, selling AI Employees to large enterprises, government and semi-government entities, banks, telcos and BPOs.

This is a builder role. You will own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting to signed contract, and help shape how Ema enters the region: which sectors we lead with and which lighthouse customers we land first. You will work closely with Solution Architects, Product and our post-sales Customer Value Engineering team, and report to Ema's Global Head of Sales.

The role suits an Account Executive from enterprise SaaS, AI, automation or cloud who already has a network of senior buyers in the Gulf and wants to build a region from the ground up.


Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation: Prospect outbound into target accounts across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, and build a territory plan that prioritises government and semi-government entities, financial services, telcos, BPOs and large family-owned groups.

  • Client Engagement: Build relationships with C-level and senior leaders (CIOs, CHROs, COOs, Chief Digital and AI Officers), and lead executive conversations on how AI Employees transform HR, IT, customer service and finance operations.

  • Pipeline Management: Build and track a qualified pipeline in HubSpot, move accounts through each sales stage, and forecast accurately.

  • Negotiation & Deal Closing: Work with internal teams to navigate regional procurement, including RFPs, tenders and vendor registration, and negotiate pricing, terms and contracts to close enterprise deals.

  • Market Strategy: Track the regional AI landscape, including national AI strategies, data residency and sovereign cloud requirements, and competitor moves, and feed what you learn back into Ema's product and go-to-market plans.

  • Regional Presence: Represent Ema at regional industry events and executive forums, and help land the reference customers that anchor Ema's Middle East business.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of enterprise sales, with at least 3 years selling SaaS, AI, automation or cloud into the GCC. A track record of closing net-new business and hitting quarterly and annual targets.

  • Deal Size: Proven success closing enterprise deals of $500K or more, ideally including government, semi-government or regulated-sector buyers in the UAE or Saudi Arabia.

  • Regional Network: Established relationships with senior buyers in the Gulf, and working knowledge of regional procurement, tendering and vendor registration.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal English. You can explain complex AI concepts simply to audiences of any seniority or technical depth.

  • Sales Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other CRM or sales tools.

  • Location: Based in Dubai, or willing to relocate, with regular travel across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Product Knowledge: A solid grasp of enterprise AI and how it applies to real business workflows, so you can communicate Ema's value with credibility.

  • Sales Expertise: Proven ability to prospect, build relationships and negotiate high-value deals with senior executives, including pipeline built through cold outreach.

  • Technical Acumen: You pair selling skills with enough technical understanding to discuss integrations, security, data residency and deployment options with IT and risk teams.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Personable yet persistent, and comfortable with relationship-led selling and long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced startup and are comfortable building Ema's presence in a new region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluency in Arabic.

  • Experience selling HR tech, ITSM, contact-centre or customer-experience technology in the region.

  • Experience opening a new territory or being an early go-to-market hire for a company entering the Middle East.

What We Value

  • Consistent Success: A record of closing large enterprise deals and meeting or beating ambitious targets.

  • Customer Focus: You understand customer needs deeply, navigate complex procurement and tailor solutions that deliver measurable value.

  • Collaboration: You work across teams, influence without authority and build strong relationships with colleagues in other time zones.

  • Adaptability & Learning: You are eager to keep learning, especially about AI, and you pick up new products quickly.

  • Ownership: You act like a founder of the region, not just a seller in it.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.
